#  DATASET_DESCRIPTION: This data set contains selected well characteristics 
#			for wells included in a report that summarizes the 
#			quality of water from wells sampled in principal 
#                       aquifers of the United States by the NAWQA program 
#			from 1991-2010. 
#			
#  DATA_SET FORMAT:	Tab-delimited ascii text
#  DATA_SET URL:	TBD
#
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
#  REPORT TITLE: 	Water quality in principal aquifers  
#			of the United States, 1991-2010
#

#  REPORT URL:		http://pubs.usgs.gov/circ/1360
#

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  METADATA Data Description:  
#
#  ABSTRACT:  This data set contains well depth, depth to water, and
#             degree of aquifer confinement, for wells used in a report
#             that summarizes the quality of water in principal aquifers 
#             sampled by the NAWQA program, 1991-2010. The data were 
#             retrieved from the NAWQA internal Data Warehouse in 
#             August 2010. 
#	
#
#  SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION:
#   	PROCEDURES USED:
#	PROCESS STEP:
#	  Well depth, depth to water, and degree of aquifer confinement
#         were retrieved from the NAWQA internal Data Warehouse (DWH)  
#	  in August 2010. Depth to water was retrieved as parameter
#         code 72019 "Depth to water level" and aquifer confinement
#         was retrieved as parameter "Aquifer Type ID".
#         
#	  Depth to water was retrieved using the decadal sample identifier
#         "FULL NETWORK CYCLE"; this parameter identifies samples collected 
#         during the decadal sampling of all wells in a groundwater
#         study as part of NAWQA Groundwater Status and Trends assessments.
#
#         Data for some sites, for which the decadal sample identifier
#         was not populated, were retrieved using a condition that specified
#         "Staid" or "Su Code" equal to the station identifiers or ground-
#         water studies of interest. These sites included the DWGS sites
#         and sites for other studies that were not considered part of 
#         NAWQA Groundwater Status and Trends decadal assessments.
#
#	PROCESS STEP:
#	  For depth to water, multiple measured values were retrieved for
#         wells that were sampled as part of more than one NAWQA Groundwater 
#         Status and Trends decadal assessment. The measured value associated 
#         with the most recent decadal sampling of the well was selected for
#	  inclusion in the data set.
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#	  The degree of aquifer confinement was simplified to eliminate
#         distinctions between single and multiple aquifers.
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#	  The 15-digit station identifier was replaced with a sequential
#	  well identifier.
#
#
# Related_Tabular_Data_Sets:  
#	pasum_pub.archival_file_summary.txt
#	pasum_pub.wellsites.txt	
#	pasum_pub.field.txt		
#	pasum_pub.majors.txt
#	pasum_pub.tes.txt
#	pasum_pub.nutrients.txt
#	pasum_pub.radon.txt
#	pasum_pub.pesticides.txt
#	pasum_pub.pesticides-CAL.txt
#	pasum_pub.vocs.txt
#	pasum_pub.vocs-CAL.txt
#
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  METADATA Basic documentation of dataset elements:
#
#     DATA FIELD LABELS:
#
#	well_identifier
#	well_depth
#       measure_date_depth_to_water
#	R_72019_depth_to_water
#	V_72019_depth_to_water
#	confinement
#	
#
#     DATA TYPES: 
#
#	Note:  The row in the data file that follows the row of variable 
#	names describes the width of the field and the data type. 
#	Code:	Variable Type		Variable Length
#	----------------------------------------------------------------
#	s 	text variable		numeric value preceding code 
#	n	numeric variable	numeric value preceding code
#									 
#	For example: 15s indicates a 0- to 15-character text variable whereas
# 	9N indicates a 0- to 9-digit numeric variable.
#
#
#     DATA SOURCES:
#	DWH	= USGS NAWQA data warehouse, accessible publicly at: 
#                    http://water.usgs.gov/nawqa/data
#
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  METADATA Detailed documentation of dataset elements:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: SITE IDENTIFICATION
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: well identifier
#       Data Field Description: sequential identifier; the first 4 letters
#		are abbreviations representing the principal aquifer or group 
#		of principal aquifers in which the well is located for aquifers
#		that are the subjects of regional principal aquifer assessments,  
#		which are published in separate U.S. Geological Survey Circular
#		reports, as follows:
#		DENV = Denver Basin aquifers, Circular 1357
#		UFSF = Upper Floridan and Surficial aquifers, Circular 1355
#		GLAC = Glacial aquifer, Circular 1352
#		HPGW = High Plains aquifer, Circular 1337
#		METX = Mississippe Embayment-Texas coastal uplands aquifer
#		  system and Mississippi River Valley Alluvial aquifer, 
#		  Circular 1356
#		NACP = Northern Atlantic Coastal Plain aquifer system, 
#		  Circular 1353
#		PBVR = Piedmont, Valley and Ridge, Blue Ridge, and Early
#		  Mesozoic basin aquifers, Circular 1354
#		SWPA = Basin and Range basin-fill, California Coastal basin, 
#		  Central Valley, and Rio Grande aquifers, Circular 1358 
#		WEVO = Columbia Plateau, Snake River Plain, and Hawaiian
#		  aquifers, Circular 1359
#		OTHR = All other aquifers
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: calculated
#       Retrieval Date: not applicable
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#		
#	Data FIELD GROUP: WELL CHARACTERISTICS
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: well_depth
#       Data Field Description: depth of well
#	Data Field Length/Type: 8n
#	Data Units: feet below land surface
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: August 2010
#		
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: measure_date_depth_to_water
#       Data Field Description: measurement date for depth to water,
#               from DWH item "Result Datetime"
#	Data Field Length/Type: 12s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: modified from DWH
#       Retrieval Date: August 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: R_72019_depth_to_water
#       Data Field Description: remark field for depth to water:
#		E = the site was flowing recently
#		F = the site was flowing, but head could not be measured
#		O = an obstruction was encountered in the well above the
#		    water surface
#		P = the site was being pumped
#		R = the site had been pumped recently
#		S = a nearby site that taps the same aquifer was being pumped
#		Z = other conditions that would affect the measured water 
#		    level
#		- = null
#	Data Field Length/Type: 1s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: August 2010
#		
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: V_72019_depth_to_water
#       Data Field Description: depth to water
#	Data Field Length/Type: 8n
#	Data Units: feet below land surface
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: August 2010
#		
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: confinement
#       Data Field Description: estimated degree of confinement for the 
#		aquifer from which the well withdraws water, from DWH
#               item "Aquifer Type Id"
#	Data Field Length/Type: 14s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Retrieval Date: August 2010
#		
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  End METADATA documentation
#
#  BEGIN DATA: pasum_pub.wellchars.txt
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
